title: Trump Family Wants A Bank For Its Crypto Business. They Get Initial Approval
summary_full: World Liberty Financial, the Trump-linked crypto company, has received the green light from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), the US banking regulator.
summary_public: World Liberty Financial, the Trump-linked crypto company, has received the green light from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), the US banking regulator.
